variety_description: A late maturity, medium slender, tall variety suitable for submergence prone rice ecology. Developed by RARS, Jorhat in 2018 by introgression of sub-1 gene in high yielding variety Ranjit. Ensures good grain yield even when submerged up-to two weeks. This variety can regenerate. Because of its high productivity under submerged conditions, it is getting popular among farmers from low lying areas. Tolerant to leaf blast and susceptible to leaf blight.
